Daily Quiz.question: ১) Which one is not correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A number of people are going on a trip.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The number of days in a week are seven.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Fifty thousand dollars is a lot of money.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Ten miles is a long distance.
Daily Quiz.exp: A number of+plural noun+plural verb. The number of+plural noun+singular verb. নির্দিষ্ট দূরত্ব, ওজন, সময়, অর্থ দেখতে Plural হলেও এক্ষেত্রে Singular verb হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Choose the correct sentence-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) There have been a number of telephone call today.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The view of these disciplines vary from time to time.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The effect of that crime are likely to be devastating.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The crowd was wild with excitement.
Daily Quiz.exp: Correct sentences are- There have been a number of telephone calls today. The view of these disciplines varies from time to time.The effects of that crime are likely to be devastating. And the word ‘crowd’ is singular.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which one is not plural in number?
Daily Quiz.exp: Corrigenda, Brethren and Data are plural in number. Singular form of these are Corrigendum, Brother and Datum. The plural form of Dogma is Dogmas.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which one isn’t all time singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: Spectacles is all time plural.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) I can play ___ flute.
Daily Quiz.exp: বাদ্যযন্ত্র বাজানোর ক্ষেত্রে the ব্যবহৃত হয়। তবে play on থাকলে the ব্যবহৃত হয় না।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) There is ___ dust on these books.
Daily Quiz.exp: some, a lot of হয় countable/uncountable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে। যেমনঃ a lot of dust, a lot of books, some coffee, some books। lots of হয় countable plural noun এর ক্ষেত্রে। যেমনঃ lots of books।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Which of the following does not add the ‘ves’ in the plural form?
Daily Quiz.exp: Roof-এর plural form ‘Roofs’.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Which one is singular?
Daily Quiz.exp: Gallows অর্থ ফাঁসিকাঠ।

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) The man waiting to take the test was very nervous. He ___ it before.
Daily Quiz.exp: অতীতে একটি কাজের পূর্বে আরেকটি কাজ হলে পূর্বের কাজের Past Perfect Tense হয়। এছাড়া, Before এর পূর্বে এবং After এর পর Perfect Tense হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Which one is not feminine gender?
Daily Quiz.exp: Drone অর্থ পুং-মৌমাছি।

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) The opposite gender of ‘Mare’ is-
Daily Quiz.exp: Stallion- ঘোটক এবং Mare- ঘোটকী।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The river has ___ its banks.
Daily Quiz.exp: Overflow এর past tense এবং past participle form হচ্ছে overflowed। বাক্যটি Present Perfect Tense এর উদাহরণ।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Which one is incorrect?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Bread and butter is my favourite.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The horse and carriage is ready.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Time and tide waits for none.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Two and two makes four.
Daily Quiz.exp: ‘and’ দ্বারা যুক্ত noun/pronoun একই ব্যক্তি/ভাব/অর্থ প্রকাশ করলে singular verb হয়। তবে এর ব্যতিক্রম হচ্ছে ‘Time and tide wait for none’.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Example of all-time masculine gender is-
Daily Quiz.exp: Amazon, shrew এবং siren হচ্ছে all-time feminine gender. Parson (পাদ্রী) হচ্ছে all-time masculine gender.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Onion prices have ___ too much this month.
Daily Quiz.exp: মূল্য বা তাপমাত্রা বৃদ্ধি বুঝাতে ‘rise’ ব্যবহৃত হয়। বাক্যটি Present Perfect Tense। ‘rise’ এর past participle form হচ্ছে ‘risen’।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Which one is correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The Lake Baikal is in Russia.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The Lake Baikal is in the Russia.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Lake Baikal is in Russia.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Lake Baikal is in the Russia.
Daily Quiz.exp: একটি মাত্র পর্বত, দ্বীপ বা হ্রদ বুঝালে তার পূর্বে the বসে না।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Use the right tense: Shihab ___ for a new room-mate before he finally succeeded.
Daily Quiz.exp: অতীতের দুটি ক্রমিক ঘটনার ক্ষেত্রে একটির আগে অন্যটি চলছিল এরূপ বুঝাতে চলমান কাজটি হয় Past Perfect Continuous এবং অন্যটি হয় Past Indefinite।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Correct sentence of the following is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A pair of pants are in the drawer.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) This pair of scissors is dull.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The trousers I had was blue in color.
Daily Quiz.exp: Pants, scissors, jeans, trousers are always considered as plural and the verb should also be plural. In order to use them as singular, ‘a pair of’ must be added and then the verb will be singular.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Which one of the following is not a common gender?
Daily Quiz.exp: Emperor এর Feminine gender হচ্ছে Empress।

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Which one is incorrect?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Each girl needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Every girl needs  proper knowledge about nutrition.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Every of the girls needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Each of the girls needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Daily Quiz.exp: বাক্যে each/every থাকলে singular noun এর সাথে singular verb হয়। Each of থাকলে plural noun এর সাথে singular verb হয়।
